title: Specs Settings
description: Choices about a run rather than facts about a library. Changing a setting produces different output, never incorrect output.

SourceEntry.description: A source the workspace reads from.

key.description: Figma file key the source reads from.

fetch.description: Artifacts to download for this source (e.g. file, variables, styles, icons).

Settings.description: Run settings, grouped by concern. Each concern that owns a location carries its own directory.

author.description: Author recorded in generated spec metadata.

curation.description: Which components of a library a run produces specs for. (ADR-093)

defaultSelection.description: The signal a first pass derives selection from. READY_FOR_DEV selects the components the library marks ready, and selects every component set and standalone component when the library marks none. ALL selects every component regardless of marking.

oneOf.description: Selects the components the library marks ready, falling back to every component set and standalone component where the library marks none.
Selects every component regardless of marking.

preserveManualSelections.description: Whether a hand-edited selection outranks a later change to the library signal. When false, a component whose signal changed takes the new signal, overriding an edit. A component whose signal did not change keeps its recorded selection either way. Defaults to true.

includeDependencies.description: Whether the components a selected component is built from are selected too, transitively. What counts as being built from something is a convention, not a setting.

data.description: Source acquisition: what to fetch, and where fetched artifacts, computed caches, and extracted assets are kept.

directory.description: Directory holding fetched downloads, computed caches, extracted assets, and authored inputs.

sources.description: Sources the workspace reads from, keyed by source name.

spec.description: The generated spec: where it lands, how it is split, what it contains, and how values are serialized.

directory.description: Directory the generated spec is written to.

oneOf.description: JavaScript Object Notation.
Human-readable YAML, on the grounds that a spec is read and hand-edited far more often than it is parsed.

keys.description: Key naming convention applied to anatomy keys, prop keys, and references to them. Every value other than SAFE is a lossy projection of the Figma name. Defaults to CAMEL.

oneOf.description: Preserves the Figma name's structure without corrupting special characters, at the cost of keys code cannot address directly.

oneOf.title: camelCase
oneOf.description: The casing every code consumer of a spec already uses.
A tree carrying layout properties.
Parent-child relationships only, with no layout properties.
Both representations, at the cost of saying the same structure twice.
A DTCG-aligned object carrying the token path and its `$type`, with no tool-specific metadata.
The token path alone as a plain string — the most compact form, for pipelines that already hold a registry.
As TOKEN, plus a `$extensions["com.figma"]` block of raw Figma identifiers, for debugging and migration tooling.
The raw Figma-native name as a plain string, for token systems that mirror the Figma variable structure directly.
A token object supplied through `applyCustomTokens` and used verbatim. A reference with no custom object falls back to TOKEN_FIGMA_EXTENSIONS.
The Web code-syntax name a designer set in Figma. Falls back to TOKEN where none is defined.
The iOS code-syntax name. Falls back to TOKEN where none is defined.
The Android code-syntax name. Falls back to TOKEN where none is defined.

color.description: Color value output format. Defaults to HEXA, an 8-digit hex string carrying alpha.

oneOf.description: A 6-digit hex string. Discards alpha, so a translucent colour reads as opaque.
An 8-digit hex string carrying alpha — the most compact form that survives a round trip.
CSS `rgb()` functional notation.
CSS `rgba()` functional notation with alpha, which is what Figma labels "CSS" in its colour picker.
CSS `hsla()` functional notation.
Figma's native colour model, also known as HSV. Not a CSS function.
CSS Color Level 4 perceptually uniform cylindrical notation.
CSS Color Level 4 perceptually uniform rectangular notation.
A full `ColorObject` with its colour space and components, preserving fidelity with no lossy conversion.

variantDepth.description: Depth of variant expansion; 9999 for unlimited.

oneOf.description: One level of variant properties.
Two levels of variant properties.
Three levels of variant properties.

oneOf.title: Unlimited
oneOf.description: A sentinel rather than a depth. Every variant property dimension is expanded.
Every variant carries its complete data, repeating whatever it shares with the default.
A variant carries only what differs from the default, which the reader layers over it.

collapsePrimitiveWrapper.description: Strip a root container that only wraps one child and promote the child to spec root. A text or glyph leaf requires the wrapper to carry no meaningful container styles (ADR-058); a slot child needs no style test, because both nodes are containers, and the slot's value wins on any shared key (ADR-083). Defaults to true.

promotePrimitives.description: Primitive layers in composed example content are promoted to instances of the design system's own components, using conventions.primitives. A component's own anatomy is never promoted. Opt-in: promotion restructures composed content. (ADR-074, ADR-085)

emptyVariants.description: Include layered variants that contain no elements.

defaultSlotContent.description: Include slot content examples in output (ADR-050).

overrides.description: Instance elements carry the style patches a placed instance applies inside the component it instances. One choice read at every boundary: generation emits them, render applies them, the code emitters honour them. Distinct from the overridable annotation in styles.schema.json, which declares which properties an override may set. (ADR-119)

splitComponents.description: Write one file per component rather than a single combined library file.

splitConcerns.description: Write one file per concern (api, styling, variants) rather than a single component file.

useSubfolders.description: Nest each component's files in a subfolder named for the component.

roles.description: Read Figma Dev Mode annotations and emit anatomy.<element>.role (ADR-067). The on-switch for the role feature: when false, annotations are not read and no role is emitted. Defaults to false.

roleValidation.description: Severity for unmet required role obligations, such as a control with no accessible-name source (ADR-067). A setting rather than a convention: it describes how strict a run should be. 'warn' emits a diagnostic and continues; 'error' fails the transform. Defaults to 'warn'. Conflicts are errors regardless.

oneOf.description: Emits a diagnostic and continues.
Fails the transform.

assets.description: Shared resources every code output points at, whatever the platform: icons, images, generated CSS, fonts.
